neighbours.label: Nouns for a person's social ties and contacts (friends, friendships, relationships, contacts, acquaintances, phone calls)
fire: Moving abroad meant leaving behind most of her friends from school.
He built up a long list of contacts while working in Berlin.
Therapy can help you repair damaged relationships with your family.
She lost touch with many acquaintances after changing jobs.
The internet helps teenagers form friendships across borders.
A good salesman spends most of his day returning phone calls.
Retired workers often miss their former colleagues and friends.
Divorce can strain friendships that were built over many years.
quiet: Moving abroad meant leaving behind most of her books from school.
He built up a large stock of recipes while working in Berlin.
Therapy can help you repair damaged muscles in your back.
She lost track of many invoices after changing jobs.
The internet helps teenagers form opinions across borders.
A good salesman spends most of his day filling in forms.
Retired workers often miss their former routines and habits.
Divorce can strain savings that were built over many years.
